text: Python is a high-level programming language widely used for artificial intelligence and machine learning.
Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence that enables systems to learn from data and improve over time.
Artificial intelligence refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines.
Streamlit is an open-source Python library used to build interactive web applications quickly.
Vector databases store data in the form of embeddings and allow semantic search.
Endee is a vector database used for storing and retrieving embeddings efficiently.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines retrieval of relevant documents with language models to generate accurate responses.
Chatbots are AI systems designed to interact with users through text or voice.
Memory in AI allows systems to retain past interactions and use them for better responses.
